# DK Coaching

> DK Coaching is the practice of Devika Kapoor, a Life & Work Design Coach based in Manchester, United Kingdom. Everything is built on one idea: living by design, not by default. Individuals come for life design coaching; organisations come for workshops, programmes, speaking and facilitation, including staff development and employee coaching.

## Services

- [Self by Design](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/self-by-design): one-to-one life design coaching for people in transition. Flagship three month programme, £1,500, payable in three monthly instalments of £500.
- [Work by Design](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/work-by-design): workshops, programmes and speaking on careers, freelancing and what comes next, with staff development and employee coaching for organisations and teams. Trusted by organisations including the NHS, Merseyrail, Reform Radio, the King's Trust and the Royal College of Physicians.
- [Clarity Intensive](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/clarity-intensive): a single deep-dive coaching session, 90 minutes. £250.
- [The Pivot Pack](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/pivot-pack): three sessions for people navigating a career change. £550.

## Method

Every engagement follows three steps: Understand, Reframe, Design. The signature framework is the Personal Operating System, which makes how a person actually operates visible so it can be redesigned deliberately.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/blog): essays on life design, career change and development as infrastructure.
- [Career Change at 30](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/blog/career-change-at-30): why it is not too late and how to do it properly.
- [Work by Design: development is infrastructure](https://dkcoaching.co.uk/blog/work-by-design-development-is-infrastructure): why the organisations that win the next five years treat development as infrastructure, not a perk.
